data_findings_reported_not_worked_around.what: 20260525 carries five session labels that cannot all be true of one session: holiday.effect = 'closed'; flow_calendar.cme_holiday = true; flow_calendar.cme_session_class = 'partial_session'; flow_calendar.cme_early_close = false; flow_calendar.is_cme_business_day = false. 'closed' contradicts 'partial_session', and 'partial_session' contradicts 'early_close = false'.
data_findings_reported_not_worked_around.how_i_resolved_it: The spawn parameter states plainly that 0525 TRADED as a thin but real scored session, and cme_session_class = 'partial_session' in the LIVE (never-frozen, per _mask_note) flow_calendar agrees with it. holiday.effect='closed' is the coarse US-holiday label (banks / cash market), not a screen-closure statement. I therefore take the session as Sun 2026-05-24 18:00 ET reopen -> Mon 2026-05-25 close, under the S104.1 Sunday fold which puts the reopen hours in the Monday trade date.
data_findings_reported_not_worked_around.the_residual_ambiguity_and_why_it_does_n: The CLOSE TIME stays ambiguous between 13:00 ET (CME's published Memorial Day early close, which 'partial_session' implies) and 17:00 ET (which cme_early_close=false implies). I did not guess. I built the p50 path FLAT from 12:00 ET onward so the emitted day-move is insensitive to which convention the scorer uses: +170 at 12:00 versus +180 at the 16:00-17:00 bucket, a 10 USD difference. My number stands unchanged under either close. THIS is the item I would have stopped on had it been decision-blocking; it is not, and the flat-tail construction is a principled response to the ambiguity rather than a workaround, because a thin holiday afternoon with no catch-up desks is the one session where a flat post-noon tail is also the correct forecast.

cross_cutting_finding.the_general_rule_proposed: After a scheduled positioning publication that lands INSIDE a session, read the SIGN of the post-publication phase net flow, not just the WoW. CROSSES to the publication's implied side = REPRICED, seam prior EXTINGUISHED. DECAYS toward zero without crossing = deceleration only, seam prior LIVE and CARRIED. The incumbent plays (boundary.seam_gap_up_prior_on_worsening_cot, positioning.covering_self_limiting_cot_wow_gate) fire on the WoW sign alone; this adds a CONSUMPTION test on the D-1 tape. Crucially the test is open-time, non-price and BLIND-AVAILABLE - it sits in exactly the slot the price mask leaves empty, where the brain currently has only the refine-side flow_conviction gate.
cross_cutting_finding.no_free_constants: The test is a SIGN comparison (phase net crosses zero or does not) plus the already-published WoW sign. Nothing is tuned and no threshold is introduced.
cross_cutting_finding.falsifier: If the 06-01 reopen prints flat or DOWN despite pctile 0.94, WoW -38,123 and a non-crossing phase-3 net of -59, the rule is wrong on the best instance it will ever be handed and must be marked down, not excused. Conversely, if my 20260525 seam prints a MATERIAL gap in either direction despite a fully-repriced (crossing) publication, the extinction half is wrong. Both halves are testable inside this one block, which is the point.
cross_cutting_finding.n_and_honesty: n=2 publications, one of each arm, in a single block. Honestly thin, and declared as such. Rides G21+ (G21 Juneteenth 06-19 and G22 Independence Day 07-03 both put a holiday seam against a Friday publication, which is the designed forward test).
cross_cutting_finding.secondary_finding_venue_split_in_the_pos: Every positioning play in the brain reads NYMEX managed-money net; only positioning_saturation_turn's gate (a) looks at ICE at all, and only at LD1. In the 05-26 report NYMEX MM added 29,942 shorts while ICE HH PENULTIMATE MM covered 51,630, moving from the 38.68th to the 65.09th 1y percentile - the complex NET COVERED in the week the NYMEX book set a one-year record short. Proposed as a SIZE damper, never a sign gate, and flagged as a data-availability item: the state serves ICE LD1 / PEN / basis / index on every day and no play consumes PEN.
cross_cutting_finding.tertiary_finding_the_staleness_warning_n: The group-wide 'contract_structure / squeeze_watch / options_surface are frozen and squeeze_watch.active is a false positive' warning, correctly raised by C, D and E, is only true FROM 2026-05-28.
